Passively grants ? Aim Assist, 10 Airborne Effectiveness, and a ?x ADS Duration Multiplier.

Bonuses are doubled? while no allies are within 15 meters.

enhanced (
#e Stronger effect.
)

Passively grants #e${10+#d} Aim Assist, #e${10+#f} Airborne Effectiveness, and a #e${0.9-#g}x ADS Duration Multiplier.

Stat bonuses are doubled and the ADS Duration Multiplier is decresed to #e${0.8-#g}x while no allies are within 15 meters.

enhanced (
var d = 1
var f = 2
var g = 0.05
#e Aim Assist bonus is increased by 1 (2 with no nearby allies), Airborne Effectiveness bonus is increased by 2 (4 with no nearby allies), and the ADS Duration Multiplier in both cases is decreased by 0.05.
)
